finding: Integer mean-distance selector fits both visible demos but disagrees on query 0.
limits: One source-bound pre-repair lesson and one discrepant query; not a claim of universal ambiguity.
program:
(rule!
  (let* ([pivot (first (find-color g 5))]
         [pr (first pivot)] [pc (second pivot)]
         [sources
          (for*/list ([r (in-range (rows g))] [c (in-range (cols g))]
                      #:when (and (not (= (at g r c) 0))
                                  (not (= (at g r c) 5))))
            (list r c (at g r c)))]
         [distance (lambda (cell)
                     (+ (abs (- (first cell) pr))
                        (abs (- (second cell) pc))))]
         [selected
          (for/fold ([best (first sources)]) ([cell (in-list (rest sources))])
            (if (> (distance cell) (distance best)) cell best))]
         [color (third selected)])
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([cell (in-list sources)])
      (if (= (third cell) color)
          (set-cell out (- (* 2 pr) (first cell))
                        (- (* 2 pc) (second cell)) color)
          out))))
repair: Strengthen the second witness to separate true and integer means; explicitly audit both meanings of mean and centroid.
rival_program:
(rule!
      (let* ([pivot (first (find-color g 5))]
             [selector pivot] [reflection pivot]
             [sources (for*/list ([r (in-range (rows g))] [c (in-range (cols g))]
                        #:when (and (not (= (at g r c) 0)) (not (= (at g r c) 5)))) (list r c))]
             [colors (sort (remove-duplicates (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) sources)) <)]
             [distance (lambda (p) (let ([dr (- (first p) (first selector))] [dc (- (second p) (second selector))]) (+ (abs dr) (abs dc))))]
             [score (lambda (color) (let ([cells (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) color)) sources)]) (/ (apply + (map distance cells)) (length cells))))]
             [chosen (for/fold ([best (first colors)]) ([color (in-list (rest colors))]) (if (> (score color) (score best)) color best))] [selected (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) chosen)) sources)])
        (for/fold ([out g]) ([p (in-list selected)])
          (let ([rr (- (* 2 (first reflection)) (first p))] [cc (- (* 2 (second reflection)) (second p))])
            (if (in-bounds? rr cc (rows g) (cols g))
                (set-cell out rr cc (at g (first p) (second p))) out)))))
root_cause: The protected DSL uses integer division: 22/4 and 26/5 both become 5. On seed 0 a numeric-color tie then selects the farthest color in both demos.
